title: Adsorption and inhibition mechanism of pyrazole derivatives on carbon steel: combined electrochemical, surface, and DFT/MD study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15531-15552
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00508J, Paper
Open Access

A. Barrahi, A. Marzaq, R. Saddik, S. Tighadouini, F. Benhiba, M. El Faydy, B. Dikici, M. Abdallah, I. Warad, A. Zarrouk
PMB and PMI pyrazole derivatives were investigated as corrosion inhibitors for carbon steel in acidic medium using PDP, EIS, surface analysis, DFT and MD simulations. Both compounds showed strong adsorption on the steel surface and significant inhibition efficiency.
